article.title: After three years of genocide, Gaza’s olive harvest is going extinct
article.author: Tareq S. Hajjaj
article.content: The Israeli army has bulldozed over 1.6 million olive trees in Gaza since the beginning of the genocide in 2023, threatening the livelihood and heritage of olive farming communities, and the survival of a centuries-old Palestinian cultural tradition.
